## Submodules

Clone with added `--recurse-submodules`.  
Update submodules with `git submodule update --init --recursive`.  
See [Project Structure](../how-to/install-kimmdy.qmd#notes-on-the-project-strucure).

## Plumed

Plumed is no longer required for the homolysis plugin, which calculates bond
distances directly from the trajectory with MDAnalysis.
PLUMED support in KIMMDY (`plumed`, `use_plumed`, `break_plumed`) is deprecated
and will be removed in a future release.
If you still use it,
note that historically, gromacs would need to be compiled with Plumed, however
since gromacs 2025, no patching is required.
Plumed needs still to get compiled and installed 
([See plumded documentation](https://www.plumed.org/doc-v2.9/user-doc/html/_installation.html))!
Make sure the `PLUMED_KERNEL` env variable is set to the path to your 
`libplumedKernel.so` (should be in `plumed/lib/`).

## What plugins do exist?

Check the [`kimmdy` github topic](https://github.com/topics/kimmdy) to find them all.

## uv related issues

For the tool installation, try uninstalling and re-installing.

For the dev installation, here are the most useful commands you might need:

Update dependencies to `pyproject.toml` content, run from kimmdy directory:
```bash
uv sync --extra all
```

Use a known set of dependency versions from `uv.lock`: 
(For downgrading pull an older `uv.lock` from github)
```bash
uv run --frozen kimmdy
```
